pitch: Grade how demoable a project is, from D to S. This is the real CLI, running in your browser on four sample projects.
welcome: [1mshowcase[0m grades how demoable a project is, from D to S, and says what it takes to reach the next tier.
Four sample projects are in ~/projects, one at each tier from D to A.
showcase check projects/*            the tier of each one
showcase check projects/notecli      what notecli needs for A
showcase manage                      browse and edit the portfolio of these four
